column18: Survey of neuromorphic edge computing: near-sensor integration, sparsity techniques, RRAM integration and security; no figures
Neuromorphic cytometry dataset; CBAM-SNN 97% accuracy, computation reduction claimed without ANN counterpart
Hybrid LLM-neuromorphic 6G edge model: 10-100x energy-per-token efficiency claimed; baseline and basis unclear
Few-spikes SNN for 5G source localization on SpiNNaker2 benchmarked against baseline ANN on Jetson Xavier NX; no figures
SNN on Loihi 2 vs CNN on Xilinx chipset: orders of magnitude better energy efficiency with maintained accuracy
NQAL SNN for DoH threat detection: 99.18% accuracy, <1 ms latency, 10x less energy than GPU-based models
SNN on Loihi 2 vs GPU ANN: up to 10x lower latency, 4x lower power; comparable accuracy
SNN access control: 87% less energy than conventional deep learning, 94% decision accuracy
Post-training quantization of SNNs: 5.2 bits average, 1.51x power reduction; quantization-only, no ANN comparison
28nm 16-core SNN chip: 3.3 pJ/SOP, 4.7 GSOP/s; MNIST 92.3% at 2.7 uJ/classification; no ANN baseline
niCNN (converted CNN): latency 2.25/2.36 ms, memory 22.11/31.84 KB, 5.2/5.8 W; beats baseline CNNs; accuracy 97.25/98.92%
NiSNN-A 2.13x more energy-efficient than counterpart CNNs on motor imagery EEG, comparable accuracy
Purely spiking graph conv network: low accuracy loss vs ANN alternatives with significantly reduced energy; no figures given
Aerial neuromorphic detection dataset; baseline of 3 SNNs and 10 DNNs reported, no efficiency metrics in abstract
Row pruning in memristive SNNs: marginal performance drop, up to two orders of magnitude energy saving after 1000 cycles
M-LIF SNN: 20x lower energy than VGG16 ANN on ImageNet; +2% accuracy vs VGG16 SNN; 3x lower latency on DVS
Single-spike conversion: energy efficiency 4.6-17.3x vs ANN baseline; accuracy loss 0.58% (CNNs), 0.90% (GCNs)
Top-K cutoff and regularization: 1.76-2.76x fewer timesteps on CIFAR-10, 1.64-1.95x on event datasets, near-zero accuracy loss
SPARSH sparse-hashing memory for SNN FPGA accelerator: over-provisioning -3.2x, access latency -77%, bandwidth utilization -68%
Unified SNN-ANN neuromorphic chip: peak 5.181 TSOPS/W (SNN), 10.372 TOPS/W (ANN); chip-level only, no task-level comparison
PDMU is an ANN sequence model; spiking variant mentioned with vague energy gains, no figures or ANN comparison
Freezing 70% of ResNet on ImageNet: 3.3x SLT compression vs dense, +14.12 accuracy points vs randomly pruned source
ANN-SNN conversion; only efficiency figure is 56x fewer timesteps; ResNet-34 SNN ~74% on ImageNet
Neuromorphic co-processors for HPC: up to 80% energy savings vs conventional processors in climate case study; no ANN baseline
